## CollectionChangedError class

The collection changed while it was being read, so no consistent result exists. The same request is correct and can be retried, from the first page if it was paged. Distinct from an invalid selection, which the caller must fix.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare class CollectionChangedError extends MactsError<'COLLECTION_CHANGED'>
```
